desc:
👗 DESIGN DRESSES, SEW THEM & RUN YOUR OWN BOUTIQUE! 🧵

🌙 RUNWAY SHOWS ON FASHION LANE EVERY 30 MINUTES: walk the carpet and win exclusive Runway Collection pieces!

✂️ Design dresses from dozens of tops, sleeves & skirts!
🧵 Cut, sew & add the finishing touches yourself!
⭐ Wow picky customers for 5-star ratings & bigger pay!
🏬 Shop fabrics, patterns & tools at Bobbin & Bolt!
🛋️ Decorate your boutique with furniture from Pillow & Plinth!
💖 Show off your dresses in your window and collect likes!
📸 Snap polaroid photo shoots of your best looks!
👥 Play with friends on a street of 12 boutiques!

🌃 When night falls on Fashion Lane, customers want party looks!

✨ New designer? Madame Bobbin shows you the ropes on your first day!

👍 Like & Favorite for more updates and new designs!
🐛 Report bugs in the Forge Virtual group
